name: Kyststier langs Oslofjorden
description_md:
Kyststier langs Oslofjorden is a waymarked hiking route in Norway. This route covers 1030.5 km and is classified as hard due to its distance and ascent.

It is part of an international waymarked hiking network. The line matches the route published by turrutebasen. The route passes Fram within 100 m, the National Theatre within 400 m, and the National Gallery within 600 m.
